Powerful .NET solution template for your projects
A production-ready solution template that provides a complete foundation for building .NET libraries and applications
Get Started

Simple but Powerful

Complete .NET development foundation with standardized project structure, automated scripts, and professional tooling for building high-quality libraries and applications.

Standardized Development

Consistent project structure, coding standards, and automated workflows ensure high-quality, maintainable code across all projects.

Easy Testing

Automated testing with C# scripts for running tests, collecting coverage, and generating detailed reports. Integrated with GitHub Actions for CI/CD pipelines.

NuGet Packaging & Publishing

Automated NuGet package creation and publishing to multiple feeds (local, dev, staging, production) with GitVersion integration and symbol package support.

Documentation Website

Built with Astro.js Starlight framework for modern, fast, and SEO-optimized documentation sites with professional theming and deployment to GitHub Pages.

AI-Powered Integration

Pre-configured Cursor rules and Kiro steering files with AGENTS.md template provide intelligent AI assistance for development and documentation tasks.
